name: Jump to a moment
author: Izumi
description: Describe a scene and the player jumps to it. Uses the episode's subtitles and a chat model you choose, on your computer or with your own key.

network.reason: Sends your question, the title and the episode's subtitle lines to the model address you enter, and nowhere else.

settings.label: Model address
settings.description: An OpenAI-compatible chat API, such as a local model server's /v1 address or your provider's API base.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: The model's name at that address.

settings.label: API key
settings.description: Leave empty for a model on this computer. Stays on this device.

settings.label: Only search what I've watched
settings.description: Skips everything after where you are now, so a search never spoils what's ahead.
